hero_description: Real fishing. Real friendship. From the waters of Wisconsin — kayak fishing, ice fishing, gear reviews, and everything in between.
about_paragraph_1: We're Scott and Adam — two buddies from Appleton, Wisconsin who'd rather be on the water than anywhere else. What started as weekend kayak trips turned into a full-blown fishing show.
about_paragraph_2: We film everything ourselves, rig our own gear, and keep it real. No sponsors telling us what to say. Just honest takes on the fish, the gear, and the Wisconsin outdoors.
ice_description: When the lakes freeze over, we don't stop. From Lake Winnebago sturgeon to panfish on the inland lakes, we're out there drilling holes and dropping lines all winter long.
newsletter_description: Trip reports, gear drops, and new episode alerts. No spam — just fishing.
